Define.Description: A Specimen Processing Activity is the minimal semantic unit of post-collection handling, representing concrete operations applied to collected specimens (e.g., drying, grinding, sieving, dehusking, filtering, preservation, homogenization) prior to laboratory analysis.

It.Uses: prov:used → whu:Specimen; whu:Device (e.g., oven, sieve, mill, filter); whu:Reagent (e.g., preservative acid)

Context.Trigger: Extract when the text describes explicit post-collection handling of specimens.

TypicalActions.Action: Filtration (e.g., 0.45 μm) and chemical preservation (e.g., HNO3 acidification)

Requirements.Requirement: Atomic: capture the smallest processing operation (not the whole lab workflow)
Traceable: record atLocation, used (specimen/device/reagent), generated (processed specimen)
Linked: connect with prov:wasInformedBy to prior collection; optionally to downstream biochemical step

Notes.Diff: Differs from whu:SpecimenCollectionActivity (sampling action before processing)
Notes.Relations: prov:used → whu:Specimen | whu:Device | whu:Reagent ; prov:atLocation → whu:EnvironmentFeature ; prov:generated → whu:ProcessedSpecimen ; prov:wasInformedBy → whu:SpecimenCollectionActivity ; optional link to → whu:BioChemicalActivityStep

Example.Text: Soil samples were air-dried at room temperature, ground, and passed through a 2 mm nylon sieve.
Rice grains were oven-dried at 60 °C, dehulled, and milled into flour prior to analysis.
Surface water was filtered through 0.45 μm membranes and acidified to pH < 2 with HNO3 for preservation.

Annotation.prov_wasInformedBy: SpecimenCollectionActivity(surface water sampling at Site A)
Annotation.prov_used: Specimen(surface water); Device(0.45 μm filter); Reagent(nitric acid)
